newsitem.title: GERMANY: Isar Amperwerke expects 96/97 sales to rise. [Corrected 18:41 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Isar Amperwerke expects 96/97 sales to rise. [Corrected 18:41 gmt]

text.p: German utility Isar Amperwerke said on Wednesday that it expects 1996/97 parent company sales of somewhat over 2.2 billion marks. (Corrects to show that forecast refers to parent company sales, not group).
Management board chairman Alfred Bayer said in Munich that it expects its earnings for the full year to the end of June 1997 to continue to rise.
Bayer said the group's financial results are expected to be higher, which would boost earnings.
The positive effects of its restructuring programme would also lift earnings, Bayer said.
Bayer said that there were no longer any loss-making units in the group structure.
